problem: The first AC8 test asserted an always-empty array and a vacuous typeof check, proving nothing.
impact: A test that looks like evidence and is not is worse than no test: it makes a criterion read as confirmed while the property stays unchecked. AC8 claims the metric reads one file and starts no traversal, and nothing verified it.
suggested_fix: Assert the observable consequence — the metric resolves in a project with no graph and no wiki, and a directory full of pages does not change its numbers.
evidence: The test built an `opened` array, never populated it, and asserted it was empty.

class_scope.enumeration_method: Reviewed every test added in this phase for vacuous assertions.

disposition.evidence: Replaced at 82b8c365 (merged as 6babe28f) with two tests: one asserts .metaproject contains only data/, the other that 20 wiki pages on disk do not change pagesTotal from the report's 50.

verification.evidence: Re-checked at 82b8c365, merged as 6babe28f: the vacuous test is gone; the two replacements assert directory contents and that on-disk pages do not affect the reported totals. No longer reproduces.

problem: AC7 (the gate cannot see the metric) was initially planned as a runtime comparison of gate verdicts.
impact: computeGate does not receive the report, so any such comparison passes trivially and would keep passing if someone later wired the metric in — the exact moment the guarantee breaks.
suggested_fix: Assert it at the type level instead, so the guard fails at compile time when the input gains the field.
evidence: computeGate takes {findings, projectMetrics, sources, config, strict}; the report never reaches it.

disposition.evidence: Implemented at 82b8c365 (merged as 6babe28f) as a conditional type over Parameters<typeof computeGate>[0] that stops compiling if wikiFreshness is added.

verification.evidence: Re-checked at 82b8c365, merged as 6babe28f: the compile-time guard is present and typecheck passes; adding wikiFreshness to the gate input would fail it. No longer reproduces.
